benchmark.name: SAT Competition 2025 Medium
benchmark.sampleDescription: 100 randomly selected instances from the SAT Competition 2025 main-track benchmark set.
benchmark.note: These local runs use 100 randomly selected SAT Competition 2025 main-track instances, a 1800-second timeout, and a 16 GB memory limit per solver.
benchmark.curveNote: Curves show cumulative solved instances over runtime. Output and proof handling follow the SAT Competition 2025 format; the virtual best line uses the fastest solved time per instance across the plotted solvers.
